claims.text: Improving neural network language models (NNLM) can involve using architectures like gate recurrent units (GRU) and dropout strategies to address overfitting.
Increasing the model size and implementing special functions, such as encoding with a changeless neural network structure, can enhance performance.
Utilizing techniques like importance sampling, word classes, and bidirectional recurrent neural networks (BiRNN) can improve NNLM performance.
Dynamic tuning of parameters during testing can lead to lower perplexity, indicating better model performance.
